title: Project Nirmal Brings 24/7 Mental Health Support to NDRF Personnel and Families
body: The pan-India initiative will provide counselling, screening, crisis support and a 24/7 multilingual helpline for NDRF personnel and families. NEW DELHI (India CSR): The NDRF Wives Welfare Association (NWWA) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Mpower, a pan-India mental-health service provider founded by Mrs Neerja Birla under the Aditya Birla Education Trust (ABET), to establish Project Nirmal. title: Desai Foundation Trust Registers as NPO on NSE Social Stock Exchange
body: Registration strengthens transparency and visibility for rural-impact work; it does not indicate that funds have been raised. NEW DELHI (India CSR): The Desai Foundation Trust has been registered as a Not-for-Profit Organisation (NPO) on the National Stock Exchange’s Social Stock Exchange (SSE), marking a governance and visibility milestone for its community programmes in rural India. NSE records the Trust under Registration No. NSESSENPO0207 , dated 3 September 2026 , with its status marked as “Registered” and validity until 2 September 2027 . title: Birla Cable Spends Rs 49.95 Lakh on CSR in FY 2025-26, Rewa Projects Get Major Share
body: Telecom cable manufacturer spends on technical education, rural development, environment, healthcare, animal welfare and culture in Madhya Pradesh NEW DELHI (India CSR®) : Birla Cable Limited, a telecommunications cable manufacturer of the MP Birla Group, spent Rs 49.95 lakh on Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) in FY 2025-26 , marginally above its prescribed obligation of Rs 49.94 lakh , with the largest allocation of Rs 27.64 lakh going towards infrastructure-related work at the M.P. title: The Gund Brothers Honoured with Asian-African Leadership Awards for Excellence in Automobile & Ancillary Sector
body: New Delhi: The Gund Brothers, Rhythm Gund and RitanshuGund , have been honoured with the prestigious Asian-African Leadership Awards 2026 at the 8th High Level Diplomatic Meet (HLDM) – Season VIII , organised by the Asian-African Chamber of Commerce and Industry (AACCI) . The awards recognise their contribution to the automobile and ancillary sector , with the Gund Brothers receiving individual honours for their entrepreneurial leadership. title: CSR: Hindustan Zinc Fuels the Dreams of Over 2 Million Girls and Women through Social Interventions
body: UDAIPUR: Every girl deserves more than an opportunity to study, she deserves the freedom to imagine a future for herself. Hindustan Zinc, the world’s largest integrated zinc producer and one of the world’s top ten silver producers, are taking steps to ensure every girl has the right to dream without any limits. Through initiatives spanning from school, higher education to sports and skill development, Hindustan Zinc has impacted lives of over 2 million girls and women, building an ecosystem where a girl can learn, aspire and lead. title: COWBERRY Aims to Transform India’s Organic Food Market Through Verification
body: India’s organic food market is experiencing significant growth as consumers become increasingly conscious of the quality of their food products. The burgeoning demand has led to questions regarding the authenticity of items marketed as organic. Historically, the industry relied heavily on claims made by brands, creating a gap in trust between consumers and producers. The need for assured organic product verification has prompted a movement in the sector, with stakeholders questioning whether the products being sold genuinely meet organic standards. title: West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari Lays Foundation Stone For 2,000-Bed Adani Arogya Mandir
body: Kolkata, 24 September 2026: Hon’ble Chief Minister of West Bengal Suvendu Adhikari today laid the foundation stone for a 2,000-bed Adani Arogya Mandir at Bengal Silicon Valley Tech Hub, New Town, Kolkata. Closely aligned with West Bengal’s 2026 Healthcare Vision, the project, to be executed by the Adani Foundation, will cater to over 200,000 inpatients and more than 2 million outpatients annually and generate about 10,000 jobs. title: Our Focus Remains on Embedding ESG Priorities into the Fabric of the Organisation: Vishwa Bandhu Bhattacharya, Director – Global Sustainability, Tata Consumer Products
body: Vishwa Bandhu Bhattacharya of Tata Consumer Products discusses FY26 ESG progress, renewable energy, circular packaging, water positivity and Net Zero 2040. MUMBAI (India CSR): For an FMCG business, sustainability is no longer confined to a yearly disclosure. It shapes how products are designed, ingredients are sourced, factories use water and energy, and communities are supported. title: Jio ने लॉन्च किए AI ग्लास, जेस्चर से होगा UPI पेमेंट
body: अत्याधुनिक तकनीक का नया जादू नई दिल्ली. मार्वल्स की सुपरहीरो वाली मूवीज तो आपने देखी ही होंगी, जिसमें आयरन मैन का स्मार्ट चश्मा दर्शकों को बहुत पसंद आता है। अब जियो ने भी कुछ ऐसा ही पेश किया है। जियो का नया AI Glass आपके इशारे पर बिना मोबाइल निकाले यूपीआई पेमेंट कर देगा। यह खास प्रोडक्ट इंडिया मोबाइल कांग्रेस 2026 में प्रदर्शित किया गया। जियो के कूल प्रोडक्ट्स की झलक जियो ने अपनी पर्सनल AI वियरेबल रेंज में कैमरा ग्लास, ऑडियो ग्लास और ईयरफोन शामिल किए हैं। इनमें Scan and Pay, AI वॉयस असिस्टेंट, मल्टी-इंडियन लैंग्वेज सपोर्ट और लाइव ट्रांसलेशन जैसे आकर्षक फीचर्स दिए गए हैं। ये उत्पादन तकनीक की…
